verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs say users can install desktop apps with one click from Fedora's repositories and Flathub, and can install, update and manage packages, including with a single command. That covers the core of an official software catalog. One user reported that installing Discord and Spotify took a page of commands, so some popular proprietary apps are not one-click installs. missing for 10: evidence of catalog scale (the 'thousands' of apps is never quantified), independent hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth, and smooth installation of popular third-party apps.
